definitions.explanation: Describes speech, writing, or methods that are unnecessarily indirect and take a long time to get to the point. Always carries a negative connotation — implying the speaker or method should be more direct.

examples.japanese: {回|まわ}りくどい⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧はやめてほしい。
examples.english: I wish you'd stop being so roundabout in the way you say things.

examples.japanese: {回|まわ}りくどい⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: The explanation was so roundabout that I couldn't understand what they were trying to say.

examples.japanese: {回|まわ}りくどい⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{直接的|ちょくせつてき}→直接的：06093_chokusetsuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should tackle the problem more directly rather than taking a roundabout approach.

notes:
USAGE:
Always negative in nuance. Used when someone's speech or approach is frustratingly indirect. Can describe both verbal communication and methods of doing things.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {回|まわ}りくどい⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧ (a roundabout way of saying something)
- {回|まわ}りくどい⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧ (a long-winded explanation)
- {回|まわ}りくどい⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧ (a roundabout method)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{遠回|とおまわ}し→遠回し：08054_toomawashi⟧: indirect, roundabout — can be neutral or even tactful, unlike {回|まわ}りくどい which is always negative
- ⟦くどい→くどい：10318_kudoi⟧: persistent, long-winded — focuses on tedious repetition rather than indirectness

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {回|まわ}りくどくなかったら
